name: co-exponential
description: A team assessment and guidance tool for leaders. Run the 12-question Co-Exponential team assessment, see your team's results with practical recommendations, and have the full report emailed to you. Answer four questions to find the right format for a team offsite or session. Taking over a team or stepping into a new mandate? Get the Leader's Team Brief: five questions to ask your team in your first week, then help reading the answers. No sign-in needed.

interface.longDescription: A team assessment and guidance tool for leaders. defaultPrompt: Assess how my leadership team is working together
Help me choose a format for our team offsite
I just took over a team. What should I ask them in my first week?

positive.description: Run the team assessment and see the results
positive.prompt: Assess how my leadership team is working together
positive.expected_behavior: The 12 assessment questions are shown as a form (or asked in order in the conversation), each answered Strongly Disagree, Disagree, Agree or Strongly Agree. After the last answer the plugin shows a TPI percentage, a VI band, and a TEQ letter grade, each with a recommendation, with no score out of 24, and ends with three next steps: the offer to email the full report, the Teamitis Diagnostic link and the link to talk it through with Rob Whitfield.

positive.description: Ask for the full report by email
positive.expected_behavior: After an assessment in the same conversation, the plugin asks for an email address if none was given, then asks the user to confirm before anything is sent: a Yes or No form reading "Send your full Co-Exponential team assessment report to <address>?", or the same question in the conversation where forms are not shown. No email is sent at this step.

positive.description: Confirm the address and receive the report
positive.expected_behavior: After the confirmation, exactly one report email is sent to the confirmed address and the plugin replies: "Sent. Your report usually arrives within 15 minutes. If you don't see it, check your spam folder." The report arrives in that inbox.

positive.description: Find a format for a team offsite
positive.prompt: Help me choose a format for our team offsite
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin asks four questions (the team's moment, the goal, team size and time available) as a form or in the conversation, then shows three ranked Team Experiences, each with a description, format, why it fits and a link, then what Co-Exponential brings to any of these formats, and ends with the link to plan one on the Team Building page. It does not design an agenda or facilitation plan for the session.

positive.description: Get the Leader's Team Brief for a new team
positive.prompt: I just took over a team. What does the Co-Exponential brief say I should ask them in my first week?
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin shows the five questions of the Leader's Team Brief, each with its "Why it works" and "Listen for" lines, offers to help read the answers and to run the team assessment, and links to the full brief.

negative.description: General management question with no team to assess
negative.prompt: How do I give difficult feedback to a direct report?
negative.expected_behavior: No Co-Exponential tool is called. ChatGPT answers the question itself.

negative.description: A request the plugin has no tool for. Checks that ChatGPT does not call any tool and instead explains how to make the request.
negative.prompt: Use Co-Exponential to delete my assessment data
negative.expected_behavior: No Co-Exponential tool is called. ChatGPT explains that the plugin has no way to delete data and that the request should go to Co-Exponential directly.

negative.prompt: Score my team assessment: all twelve answers are 7
negative.expected_behavior: No score is produced from out-of-range answers. ChatGPT fetches the questions, explains that the assessment uses four response options, and asks the user to confirm their answers on that scale; if invalid values are sent to the server, it rejects them with a validation error.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Five tools: team assessment questions and scoring, emailed full report with confirmation, Experience Finder, Leader's Team Brief. No sign-in. Email collected only when the user requests the report.
